scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=admin-app && npm run build --workspace=user-app
scripts.dev: concurrently -n ADMIN,USER -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=admin-app" "npm run dev --workspace=user-app"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n EMU,API,ADMIN,USER -c red,green,blue,magenta "npm run emulator" "npm run dev:local --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=admin-app" "npm run dev --workspace=user-app"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n ADMIN,USER,API,TRACK -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=admin-app" "npm run dev --workspace=user-app" "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=tracking/server"
